info.title: CF Meet Organizations Service internal API
info.description: Internal signed API of services/organizations (cfmeet.organizations), the first-party business organization authority (Blueprint v1.0 Sections 3-5, ADR 0056). Generated from and governed by docs/api/organizations-internal-v1.md. Every /internal/v1 route requires a packages/service-auth token whose issuer holds the stated permission in the receiver's trust bundle; replayed tokens are refused. The acting user (X-CF-Acting-User) is honoured only from callers holding organization.act-for-user. Never routed by public ingress. 1.1.0 (Blueprint Sections 6-7): teams and team members, typed organization policies with compare-and-swap and effective constraints, the role / capability matrix, team context in resolve / evaluate, policy-restricted capabilities (POLICY_RESTRICTED), verified technical-scope resolution and the operator provisioning retry; provisioning is off by default. 1.2.0 (Blueprint Section 12 follow-up, CAL-007 / ORG-012 / CAL-009): per-organization Calling service binding of the organization's technical scope (operator routes GET / PUT / DELETE /internal/v1/admin/organizations/{id}/scopes/primary/service-bindings/calling; Platform Access ids only, re-verified by Platform Access at use) and resolveScope answers serviceBindings.calling.

post.summary: Create an organization (the acting user becomes OWNER)
post.description: Creates an ACTIVE organization (creationSource SELF_SERVICE, provisioningState PENDING) with the acting user as its first OWNER (joinedVia CREATOR). Per-actor creation limit: 5 per 24 hours (429 RATE_LIMITED), counted in the database. Writes an audit event and the organization.created / membership.activated outbox events in the same transaction.

put.description: Create or replace the binding. Organizations stores identifiers only (never a credential value) and does not verify them: Platform Access re-verifies the credential against the organization's triple on every forwarded request, so a wrong binding can only refuse. Repeating the recorded ids is a no-op (same version, nothing audited); expectedVersion (0 = none yet) guards replacement (409 VERSION_CONFLICT). Refused while the organization has no recorded triple (409 PROVISIONING_PENDING) and for ARCHIVED organizations (409 ORGANIZATION_ARCHIVED). A relayed acting user is recorded as boundBy. Audited (scope.service_binding_set).

401.description: Missing, invalid or replayed service token (INTERNAL_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED).

403.description: INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED, ACTOR_NOT_ALLOWED, PERMISSION_DENIED, POLICY_RESTRICTED or MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED.

404.description: ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND.

409.description: ORGANIZATION_ARCHIVED, PROVISIONING_PENDING or VERSION_CONFLICT.

delete.description: Remove the binding (idempotent; also allowed for ARCHIVED organizations because removal only narrows). Organization calling forwarding stops at once (resolveScope answers serviceBindings.calling = null). Audited (scope.service_binding_cleared) when a binding was removed.

401.description: Missing, invalid or replayed service token (INTERNAL_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED).

403.description: INTERNAL_PERMISSION_DENIED, ACTOR_NOT_ALLOWED, PERMISSION_DENIED, POLICY_RESTRICTED or MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED.

404.description: ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND.

cfServiceAuth.name: X-CF-Service-Authorization
cfServiceAuth.description: Bearer EdDSA service token from packages/service-auth (with X-CF-Request-Id and X-CF-Correlation-Id); audience cfmeet.organizations, runtime environment, expiry, single use and the receiver-granted permission are verified.

ActingUser.name: X-CF-Acting-User
ActingUser.description: The acting user authenticated by the account authority. Honoured only from callers holding organization.act-for-user; from any other caller the request is refused 403 ACTOR_NOT_ALLOWED.

ActingUserRequired.name: X-CF-Acting-User
ActingUserRequired.description: The acting user (required for this operation; 400 VALIDATION_ERROR when absent). Honoured only from callers holding organization.act-for-user.

ActingUserVerifiedEmail.name: X-CF-Acting-User-Verified-Email
ActingUserVerifiedEmail.description: The acting user's verified email (lower-case), for email-bound invitation acceptance. Same caller rule as X-CF-Acting-User.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Replay with the same body returns the stored response (24 h); a different body returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Keyset cursor (nextCursor of the previous page).

AddTeamMemberRequest.description: Exactly one of membershipId and userId.

CreateOrganizationRequest.description: No user id, role or tenant is accepted from the body: the acting user is the signed X-CF-Acting-User.

Error.description: Error envelope (Cache-Control: no-store). Messages never contain a token, an email address or database text.

teamId.description: Team context: with organization.teams.manage a MANAGER is allowed only as that team's TEAM_MANAGER.

EvaluateResponse.description: A non-member (or unknown organization) gets NOT_A_MEMBER with null organizationStatus and role (non-enumerating). POLICY_RESTRICTED: the role holds the capability but the organization policy removes it.

ImportReport.description: imported / unchanged count rows (organizations + memberships); a differing row is reported in conflicts and never overwritten.

Invitation.description: An invitation; never the email address or the token.

token.description: The one-time invitation token (returned only here; only its SHA-256 is stored). An idempotent replay re-issues a fresh token for a still-pending invitation.

InvitationCreated.description: The created invitation and its one-time token.

LegalRegistration.description: Optional legal registration; SELF_DECLARED until an operator verifies it. createdAt of the organization is never an incorporation date.

LifecycleRequest.description: Optional body; an empty body is accepted.

MigrationExport.description: Meeting Service export (contract section 5). Checksum: SHA-256 (lower-case hex) over UTF-8 lines each followed by \n: org|{id}|{sha256hex(name)}|{slug}|{status}|{createdBy or -}|{createdAt unix microseconds} sorted by id, then mem|{id}|{organizationId}|{userId}|{role}|{status}|{createdAt unix microseconds} sorted by id. Test vector: one organization 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 'Acme Health' acme-health ACTIVE createdBy null createdAt 2026-10-04T12:00:00Z and one OWNER ACTIVE membership 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000b1 of user 00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a1 with the same createdAt give 1a212f81add323e1e9bed715699c0ba8c97b2dc22e211c84a05bca42d0908e78.

Organization.description: An organization. Imported legacy slugs keep the Meeting Service rule; new and changed slugs follow the contract pattern.

legacyMeetingProfilePolicy.description: The Meeting Service profile_policy JSON, verbatim (still enforced by the Meeting Service).

expectedVersion.description: The organization's version (bumped by the transfer).

PolicyDocument.description: Organization-level constraints (schema version 1). Defaults equal the Section 3 role matrix. A policy only removes capabilities and never touches OWNER administration.

visibility.description: Who may list members (organization.members.read). Default MEMBERS.

searchable.description: Colleague discovery hint for the Communications Hub. Default true.

invitationsAllowed.description: GUEST invitations created or accepted. Default true.

hostCreation.description: Who may host organization meetings (meetings.organization.create). Default MEMBERS.

features.description: A disabled feature removes its capabilities for every role. Defaults true.

ProfileInput.description: Profile fields. On PATCH an absent field is unchanged and null clears it; legalRegistration replaces the whole registration and is always SELF_DECLARED.

provisioningEnabled.description: Whether the Section 7 saga runs (ORGANIZATIONS_PROVISIONING_ENABLED, default false). While false organizations stay PENDING.

Reconciliation.description: Counts, the checksum of the imported rows in their current state (export algorithm), the last import and mismatches (CHECKSUM_MISMATCH, ORGANIZATION_COUNT_MISMATCH, MEMBERSHIP_COUNT_MISMATCH, IMPORT_CONFLICTS).

serviceBindings.description: Operator-recorded service bindings inside this triple (ids only; Platform Access re-verifies them at use). Section 12 follow-up.

ScopeMapping.description: The organization's technical scope mapping (ids and verification state only; Platform Access stays the tenant authority).

serviceAccountId.description: Platform Access service account in the organization's triple (non-nil).

credentialId.description: Platform Access credential of that service account (id only, never a secret; non-nil).

expectedVersion.description: Current binding version; 0 = no binding yet.

policy.description: A partial PolicyDocument merged into the current one.

parentTeamId.description: null detaches the team from its parent; absent leaves it unchanged.

Viewer.description: The acting user's membership and effective capabilities (present only for actor reads).
